# Diagnostic dump fixtures

Generated on the dbmint lab (Oracle 19.27) by `testdata/gen/run_gen.sh diag` (`sc_diag_*.sql`); files are
copied unchanged. Format: `docs/trace-format-diag.md`. Plan: `docs/PLAN-DIAG.md`.

| File | What it holds |
|---|---|
| `19c/diag_heap_pga.trc` | heap dump level 1: `pga heap`, `top call heap`, `top uga heap` |
| `19c/diag_heap_uga.trc` | levels 4 and 5: `session heap`, then the PGA heaps |
| `19c/diag_heap_sub.trc` | levels 0x10000001, 0x20000001, 0x20000005: sub-heaps, 80 heaps |
| `19c/diag_heap_contents.trc` | level 1025: chunk contents |
| `19c/diag_heap_large.trc`, `diag_heap_large_pdb.trc` | large pool, from the root and from a PDB (chunks left out) |
| `19c/diag_pga_summary.trc`, `diag_pga_detail.trc` | `pga_summary` and `pga_detail_dump` |
| `19c/diag_errorstack_l1.trc`, `diag_errorstack_l2.trc` | errorstack level 1 and 2 from inside PL/SQL |
| `19c/diag_procstate.trc` | processstate level 10 of a session holding row locks |
| `19c/diag_deadlock.trc` | ORA-00060 between two sessions |
| `19c/diag_hang.trc`, `diag_hang_event.trc` | hang analysis level 3 of a three-session chain, by oradebug and by event |
| `19c/diag_sysstate_l1.trc` | system state level 1 of the same chain |
| `../traces/19c/diag_in_10046.trc` (+ tkprof output) | a 10046 trace with an errorstack level 2 inside; it lives in `testdata/traces/19c/` since the parser tracks sections (stage 2), where the golden tests compare it with tkprof |

Over the size limit, in `testdata/big/diag/` (ignored by git, regenerated by the generator): `diag_errorstack.trc`
(level 3), `diag_in_10046_l3.trc`, `diag_sysstate_l2.trc`, `_l258.trc`, `_l266.trc`, `diag_heap_shared.trc`
(shared pool, 32.7 MB), `diag_oom_incident.trc` (an ORA-06544 incident file) with its session trace.

Sizes vary between runs (the contents dump by about 1 MB). `diag_oom` does not produce ORA-04030 on this host;
its header says what it does produce.
